name: Haus Helga
beschreibung: The Ferienhaus Helga is set in a sunny, peaceful location in Jungholz within the Tannheimer Tal, boasting wonderful views of the surrounding Allgäu Alps. The rooms and holiday apartments are furnished in a traditional alpine timber style and provide modern comforts for a relaxing break. A fully equipped kitchen is available for flexible self-catering. Right outside the door, scenic hiking and cycling trails invite guests to explore the Tyrolean landscape. In winter, family-friendly ski areas and cross-country ski tracks across the high valley can be reached in just minutes. The warm atmosphere and idyllic setting ensure a truly restorative mountain stay.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy holiday house in Jungholz in the Tannheimer Tal offering traditional rooms and panoramic views of the Allgäu Alps.
